caseName: Missouri, Kansas & Texas Railway Co. v. Truskett
caseNameFull: Missouri, Kansas and Texas Railway Company v. Truskett
summary: Error to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. James Hagerman, Mr. Clifford L. Jackson and Mr. Joseph M. Bryson for the plaintiff in error. Mr. S. M. Porter for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed, with costs, on the opinion of the court below, Railway Company v. Truskett, 104 Fed. Rep. 728, and cause remanded to the United States Court for the Northern District of the Indian Territory.
